mapper.select: select * from ohfifthlane.account_tbl where account_email = #{accountEmail} and account_password = #{accountPassword}

select account_email from ohfifthlane.account_tbl a join ohfifthlane.user_tbl u on a.account_id = u.account_id where u.user_name = #{userName} and u.user_ssn_front = #{userSSNFront} and u.user_ssn_back = #{userSSNBack}
mapper.insert: insert into ohfifthlane.account_tbl (account_email, account_password, account_level) values (#{accountEmail}, #{accountPassword}, 2)

insert into ohfifthlane.user_tbl (account_id, user_name, user_ssn_front, user_ssn_back, user_tel, user_address) values (#{accountId}, #{userName}, #{userSSNFront}, #{userSSNBack}, #{userTel}, #{userAddress})
mapper.select: select u.*, a.account_level from ohfifthlane.user_tbl u join ohfifthlane.account_tbl a on u.account_id = a.account_id where u.account_id = #{accountId}
